entry.summary: AI law startup Norm has raised a $120 million Series C round led by Kholsa Ventures, valuing the startup at $1.2 billion.

entry.title: AI Legal Startup Norm Valued at $1.2 Billion in Funding Round
entry.summary: Norm Ai has raised $120 million from investors in a new funding round to help automate legal services and rethink how the industry bills for its work.

entry.title: BAE-Backed Venture Capital Firm Expeditions Raises €197 Million Fund for European Defense Startups
entry.summary: A defense-tech venture capital firm backed by BAE Systems and the NATO Innovation Fund has raised a €197 million ($225 million) fund to help develop sovereign military technologies in Europe.
